guidance: At 7/80 HP we face three Two-Tailed Rats with 19/18/21 HP. The 18-HP rat attacks for 8, the 21-HP rat for 6, and the 19-HP rat debuffs this turn. Astra's opening Strength Potion is already being executed before your first choice. Now use Battle Trance+ early for four cards while it still gives full draw value. This turn's 14 incoming requires at least 8 block to survive if neither attacker dies; more block preserves essential HP. Killing the 8-damage or 6-damage attacker removes its current incoming, so compare actual displayed damage and block before each action. With Strength active, Perfected Strike may one-shot a rat if drawn; verify its live value. Prioritize killing an attacking rat and/or using True Grit and Defends to avoid lethal. True Grit exhausts randomly; do not count a specific removal. Duplicator remains and can double a high-impact attack or defensive card if needed to survive; spend it rather than die. Do not play a low-impact setup power or end the turn with a lethal forecast while a survival line is legal. Recalculate after every draw, random exhaust and enemy death; the controller still rejects lethal end turns. On later turns prioritize removing attackers, preserve HP until Burning Blood heals after victory, then claim rewards and favor reliable immediate damage, block or draw over speculative additions.
